Late last night, a brief notice for anyone travelling with a pet
It concerns the desk

Pet Travel Notice

Please check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head out, since a few pet travel steps have changed and we are sorry for the hassle.

<<FACT F010>> The team will help you with the right papers, kennel checks, and any holding-room needs, so please do not leave this to the last minute. Safe travel matters more than speed, and the desk will guide you through each step.

<<FACT F028>> If you are carrying a pet, please come by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for support before boarding.
